messages.subject: Frequency of Recombination
parts:
I'm using r/QTL. I wonder if we have methods to calculate frequency of
recombination. Inside program, they should definitely calculate it. Let
me know if you have information. Thank you.

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: Frequency of Recombination
parts:
est.rf() and plot.rf() can be used to estimate recombination fractions
between all pairs of markers and then plot them.

est.map() can be used to re-estimate the genetic map for all markers,
keeping marker order fixed.

karl
